3/18.04.2023

In Cr.M.P.No.3380 of 2013 the prayer has been made for quashing of the order dated 03.8.2011 passed in C/2- No.106 of 2011 whereby the learned court has been pleased to take cognizance under section 16(i)a(i)(ii) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, at Jamshedpur.

In Cr.M.P.No.227 of 2014 the prayer has been made for quashing of the order dated 03.8.2011 in C2-107/2011, whereby the leraned court has been pleased to take cognizance under section 16(i)a(i)(ii) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, at Jamshedpur.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that there is non application of judicial mind by the learned concerned court while taking cognizance.

entities.text: Ramjilal Agarwal vs The State Of Jharkhand And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the respondent State submits that the allegation is there and that is why the learned court has taken cognizance.

The Court has perused both the orders dated 3.8.2011 and finds that the said orders are not in accordance with law and there is non- application of judicial mind as the section, the name of the accused and the name of the transferring court are filled up in blank space and it has been passed in a format which suggest that there is non-application of judicial mind.

Accordingly, the orders taking cognizance dated 03.8.2011 in C/2- No.106 of 2011 and C2-107/2011,
pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, at Jamshedpur are set aside.
The matters are remitted back to the learned concerned court to pass fresh order in accordance with law.

( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) SI/
